g.text: Each line joins one combination; black bars show means. Axis scales are shared within rows.
Seen0/1/2: number of constituent targets exposed in any training condition.
In seen0, additive singles equals no effect by construction.
C3 v2 is RNA-only; strength 0.75 was selected using validation.
Controls are reused; gemgroups are technical, not independent biological replicates.
Count-like source X is not proven raw. No GEARS/STATE shown; not an official score.
